purpose: Define read-only lineage queries for tracing a DWH value or output backward to origins and forward to derived consumers without changing source data, lineage or taint state.

topics.name: DWH Lineage Query
topics.purpose: Define read-only lineage queries for tracing a DWH value or output backward to origins and forward to derived consumers without changing source data, lineage or taint state.

semantics.query_rule: Query begins from explicit canonical/data identity or lineage node identity.
semantics.backward_rule: Backward trace returns origin refs, transformation chain, remote hops and taint transitions.
semantics.forward_rule: Forward trace returns known derived values/products/consumers where indexed.
semantics.bounded_rule: Query depth/result count are bounded and configurable.
semantics.authority_rule: Lineage visibility follows applicable data/metadata authorization policy.
semantics.nonauthority_rule: Query results are projections and never mutate lineage or taint.

invariants.rule: DWH lineage and taint state remain explicit, monotonic unless an authorized transformation says otherwise, and traceable to source evidence.
